study: validation-only robustness of the frozen baseline CNN

rules.reference_scale: pooled within-architecture seed SD of validation macro F1 from the seed study (reports/runs/seed_study/summary.json); changes smaller than this are of the same size as retraining with another seed
rules.negligible: a family is 'negligible' if |macro-F1 change vs clean| < reference_scale at every level
rules.collapse: otherwise, walking clean -> mild -> severe, a family shows a 'collapse threshold' at the level reached by its largest single-step macro-F1 drop if that step is >= 0.05 and >= twice the sum of all its other positive step drops; otherwise 'gradual'
rules.hurts_most: lowest macro F1 among degraded conditions; per family, the change at the most severe level
rules.tolerated_best: family with the smallest mean |macro-F1 change| over its levels
rules.class_fails_first: per family, the first level (mild -> severe) at which any class's F1 drops by >= 0.05 vs clean; the class with the largest drop there
rules.prediction_collapse: a condition 'collapses predictions' if >= 80% of cycles are predicted as one class
rules.uncertainty: patient-level bootstrap (compare_runs.patient_bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0) of the paired macro-F1 difference vs clean; supporting only, not used by the rules
